title: Haydarpaşa railway station
scope: Complete permanent historic U-shaped passenger building, including the whole long southeast and shorter northwest wings, open rail-side court, twin cylindrical seaward corner towers with steep slate roofs and open lanterns, main steep roof and dormers, shaped central clock gable, repeated pilasters/cornices, tall arched windows and closed glazed ground doors. Original medium-fi relief and hidden courtyard/rear opening inventory. Exclude temporary restoration scaffolding, large roof railway logo, copied lettering/sculpture, quay/rocks/water, seaward kiosk, separate rear buildings, rail infrastructure and navigable interior.
axis: +X southeast along the front, +Z southwest toward the photographed seaward facade, -Z northeast into the rail-side court, +Y up.
heightPolicy: Current U-shaped parent bounds are about72.46m across the seaward front and84.74m in total depth, with a long southeast and shorter northwest return. Native7.25m height and retained8levels are preserved as conflicting map facts. Ordinary front/side picture proportions supply approximate source23.5m cornices,33m main roof ridges,34.1m clock-gable finial,28.5m tower shafts,40m tower roof necks,44.3m lantern caps/45m antenna tips and38.4m chimney cap. These are approximate visualization controls,not surveyed dimensions. One common unmodified host sample outside the seaward facade [0,43.5], 2.88518125m,suppliesY=0;occupied floor+.35m/support-3m. Exact quay,entrance,court and historic floor grades remain approximate.
limitations: One complete historic front picture and one 2024 complete front/long-side picture during restoration, both actually inspected. Permanent roofs and towers are visible. Unseen court/rear opening inventory and exact dimensions remain approximate; no further reference research needed. Permanent architectural exterior only; temporary2024 restoration scaffolding, banners, fences and roof railway logo are excluded. Original medium-fi pediments,clock and simple relief; no copied lettering,sculptural likeness or navigable interior. Exact native terrain contact requires final rendered inspection. Physical-device timings and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured.

nativeMap.basis: Q800973 and retained way/473151877 identify the historic U-shaped station passenger building. Current full principal component 35184845240709 (index45) and its two tile-edge fragments (indices28/29) share the same encoded identity and match the twin seaward towers and unequal rear wings. The small seaward strip building, quays, railway structures and independent rear buildings remain separate. Encoded IDs are not asserted to be OSM element IDs. Native 7.25m height conflicts with the clearly multi-story photographed architecture; preserve it as a conflicting map fact, not a source building height.

groundCutout.basis: Only the exact closed occupied U-shaped historic passenger floor. The open railway-side court remains unmasked and unfilled. No quay,water,kiosk,rail infrastructure or independent rear-building mask.
